facts.name: Agate Assault
facts.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Agate Assault deals 4 damage to target creature. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
• Exile target artifact.

facts.name: Betrayer's Bargain
facts.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature or enchantment or pay {2}.
Betrayer's Bargain deals 5 damage to target creature. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.

facts.name: Bot Bashing Time
facts.oracle_text: Bot Bashing Time deals 6 damage to target creature. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.

facts.name: Combustion Technique
facts.oracle_text: Combustion Technique deals damage equal to 2 plus the number of Lesson cards in your graveyard to target creature. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.

facts.name: Elspeth's Smite
facts.oracle_text: Elspeth's Smite deals 3 damage to target attacking or blocking creature. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.

facts.name: Essence Burn
facts.oracle_text: Essence Burn deals 5 damage to target black or green creature or planeswalker. If that permanent would die this turn, exile it instead.

facts.name: Faunsbane Troll
facts.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, create a Monster Role token attached to it. (Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has trample.)
{1}, Sacrifice an Aura attached to this creature: This creature fights target creature you don't control. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead. Activate only as a sorcery.

facts.name: Feed the Flames
facts.oracle_text: Feed the Flames deals 5 damage to target creature. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.

facts.name: Fiery Annihilation
facts.oracle_text: Fiery Annihilation deals 5 damage to target creature. Exile up to one target Equipment attached to that creature. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.

facts.name: Gnashing of Teeth
facts.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Target creature gets -5/-5 until end of turn. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
• Creatures target player controls get -1/-1 until end of turn.

facts.name: Malicious Eclipse
facts.oracle_text: All creatures get -2/-2 until end of turn. If a creature an opponent controls would die this turn, exile it instead.

facts.name: Narset's Rebuke
facts.oracle_text: Narset's Rebuke deals 5 damage to target creature. Add {U}{R}{W}. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.

facts.name: Obliterating Bolt
facts.oracle_text: Obliterating Bolt deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If that creature or planeswalker would die this turn, exile it instead.

facts.name: Pinecone Strike
facts.oracle_text:
Choose one or both —
• Pinecone Strike deals 3 damage to target creature. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
• Destroy target artifact token.

facts.name: Scorching Dragonfire
facts.oracle_text: Scorching Dragonfire deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If that creature or planeswalker would die this turn, exile it instead.

facts.name: Suplex
facts.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Suplex deals 3 damage to target creature. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
• Exile target artifact.

facts.name: Torch the Tower
facts.oracle_text:
Bargain (You may sacrifice an artifact, enchantment, or token as you cast this spell.)
Torch the Tower deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If this spell was bargained, instead it deals 3 damage to that permanent and you scry 1.
If a permanent dealt damage by Torch the Tower would die this turn, exile it instead.

facts.name: Wilt in the Heat
facts.oracle_text:
This spell costs {2} less to cast if one or more cards left your graveyard this turn.
Wilt in the Heat deals 5 damage to target creature. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
